title: On Complement and Supplement Ideals of Nearrings
summary: In this article we study complement ideals, and the dual concept of supplement ideals, in nearrings, both of which are generalizations of the concept of complement in a bounded modular lattice. We prove fundamental properties of complements and supplements in arbitrary nearrings. We then establish Galois connections between the ideal lattices of a nearring and of its matrix nearrings, yielding one-to-one correspondences between their respective complement and supplement ideals.
